changes.title: Flood insurance claims by county first published
changes.summary: FEMA NFIP flood insurance claims by county, state and year of loss, 1978 to 2026, for the nation, 50 states, DC and 5 territories and 2,931 counties: 586,148 claims with a loss in 2016-2025, $36.8 billion paid.
